purpose: Declarative contracts for project context enrichment, state-aware execution packets, and Operational Tray actions.

tools.name: enrich_task_with_context
tools.description: Enrich a task description with relevant project context, including active project laws, indexed components, open improvements, active runtime hints, recent decision memoirs, effective documentation sections, operational instincts, and a short list of recommended next MCP calls. Call this at task start instead of manually reconstructing context.

detail.description: Layer detail. For handoff_compact, compact returns immediate context plus available layer index; full returns complete context text.

model_context_window.description: Target main model context window used to compute enrichment token budget.

resume_budget_ratio.description: Optional override for enrichment budget as a ratio of model_context_window.

resume_budget_profile.description: Budget profile used when resume_budget_ratio is omitted.

tools.name: get_task_execution_context
tools.description: Return a compact state-aware execution packet for a task: recommended tool families/tools, required and recommended laws, risk controls, expected outputs, and allowed next transitions. Use this before acting in a specific task state instead of loading the full tool catalog or all rules.

task_id.description: Optional project task identifier for traceability.

prior_stage_recorded.description: Set true only when the previous task stage is already recorded in project memory.

stage_evidence.description: Memory/checkpoint/law refs proving the previous stage is recorded.

tools.name: operational_tray
tools.description: State-aware MCP facade for project work. Use action=inspect to get the current Operation Tray, or action=execute to run a small whitelisted tray action without loading the full MCP catalog.

tray_action.description: Whitelisted high-level action. Required when action=execute.

tool.description: Alias for tray_action, accepted for compact Operational Tray calls.

args.description: Arguments for the whitelisted tray action.

arguments.description: Alias for args, accepted for compact Operational Tray calls.

detail.description: Rule packet detail. compact returns top relevant full rules + available rule index; full can include expanded available rule details.

relevance_threshold.description: Minimum semantic relevance score for rules to appear in the available list.

top_rules_limit.description: Number of highest-relevance rules to include in full form.

available_rules_limit.description: Maximum number of additional available rules to list after top rules.

rule_id.description: Optional rule id/title to pull full details for one available rule during inspect mode.

work_token.description: Work token from start_task_session for mutating tray actions. May also be supplied inside args for compact clients.
